messages.subject: Article on RHIPE
parts:
Hello,

Recently Antonio Piccolboni wrote an article comparing different
Hadoop tools. This caught my attention

" moderately elegant, not necessarily most efficient, not necessarily
mature language for exploration purposes, Rhipe seems to fit the bill
pretty nicely. "


Could someone elaborate on possible improvements to

- moderately elegant
- not necessarily mature language

There can be improvements to the reducer to make it /much/ faster -
i'm working on that now. I'm not sure if the map stage can be made
any more faster than it is.


Regards

Saptarshi

http://www.dataspora.com/2011/04/pigs-bees-and-elephants-a-comparison-of-eight-mapreduce-languages/
